abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Brostamide lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 192 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 130 | 450 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Blood pressure control | 132 | 450 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
